George Adamu is a data engineer consultant at Strategic Data Solutions, bringing a year of experience to complex data integration projects. His work focuses on designing scalable pipelines and optimizing data workflows for clients across diverse industries. With a strong emphasis on cloud-native solutions, he leverages tools like Apache Kafka to manage real-time data streams, ensuring reliable ingestion for analytics platforms. Apache Spark underpins many of his batch processing tasks, enabling efficient transformation of large datasets. He frequently integrates Apache Airflow to orchestrate multi-step workflows, balancing reliability with operational flexibility.  

Adept at deploying containerized solutions, George uses Docker and Kubernetes to streamline deployment and scaling of data services. His expertise in Snowflake’s cloud data platform supports teams in building secure, high-performance data ecosystems. He also relies on Terraform to automate infrastructure setups, reducing manual effort and improving consistency across environments. For data transformation, dbt plays a key role in enabling clean, versioned pipelines that align with business needs.  

George approaches challenges with a focus on practical outcomes, prioritizing solutions that balance technical excellence with business impact. His goal is to empower teams through reliable, maintainable data systems that adapt to evolving requirements.
